about: Sample questions to run against the Claude project after each sync. Each lists the knowledge/ files a good answer should come from, and what the answer must include. The validator checks that every expected file exists.

questions.question: As a Product Owner, what do I bring to sprint planning?
Which report shows the incident MTTR trend, and what was it in the week of Sep 21?
What's the difference between Run work, a strategic project and Discretionary work?
must_include: cross-functional project team for strategic projects
Incident Management and Platform Health for Run

questions.question: How do I know if my idea should be Discretionary work instead of a strategic project?
What happens at Gate 1 and Gate 2?
must_include: Gate 1: Idea accepted at the intake review

questions.question: What T-shirt size is a project that needs two teams for a quarter?
As a Program Manager, how do I run capacity planning, and what is the Run allowance?
Who attends Quarterly Planning, and who signs off the plan?
As a Project Manager, what goes into a milestone plan? Is there a template?
What is our Definition of Done?
must_include: deployed or behind a feature flag

questions.question: An alert just fired on the Payments platform. What do I do first?
must_include: set severity, higher when in doubt

questions.question: What's the difference between a Sev 2 and a Sev 3 incident?
must_include: Sev 2 core service badly degraded, 30 minutes 24/7
Sev 3 non-core or workaround, 4 business hours

questions.question: As a Scrum Master, how do I run a post-incident review?
Which platform went over its error budget in September, and by how much?
Which Home Teams are over capacity in the Q4 plan?
Why didn't online first report of injury make the Q4 plan?
must_include: below the cut line of 32 team-sprints

questions.question: What playbooks does a Product Manager lead?
How do we do PI Planning in SAFe here?
must_include: says the knowledge base doesn't cover SAFe PI Planning
points to Quarterly Planning as the closest practice
